questions.q: Which authentication type is built specifically for sites and APIs that use an API key?
options: Web API
Anonymous
Organizational account
Windows
questions.explain: Web API authentication is designed for sources that authenticate via an API key — the most common case once you start pulling data from real REST APIs.

questions.q: How do you connect to a JSON file or REST API endpoint in Power BI Desktop?
options: You can't connect directly; you must download the JSON as a file first
Only Power Query Online supports JSON, not Power BI Desktop
A separate dedicated JSON connector, unrelated to the Web connector
The same Web connector used for ordinary web pages — just point it at the JSON/API URL
questions.explain: The Web connector handles web pages, JSON files, and REST API responses alike — Power BI automatically wraps JSON content as a JSON document once it detects it.

questions.q: In Navigator, what does the Web View tab show that Table View doesn't?
options: Where each detected table sits on the actual web page
A list of every image on the page
A count of how many times the page has been refreshed
The page's raw HTML source code
questions.explain: Web View highlights each detected table directly on the rendered page, which helps when it's not obvious from the table list alone which one you actually want.

questions.q: When would you switch from Basic to Advanced mode in the From Web dialog?
options: Advanced mode is required for JSON files
When you need to assemble a URL from parts, add request headers, or extend the timeout
Only when connecting to a database instead of a web page
Whenever connecting to any HTTPS site
questions.explain: Advanced mode adds URL-parts assembly, a configurable command timeout, and HTTP request header parameters — useful once a single URL box isn't enough, such as when an API key needs to go in a header.

questions.q: Once you set an authentication method for a website's address, what happens on later visits to pages under that same address?
options: Power BI switches to Anonymous automatically after the first connection
The setting only applies to the exact page, not subpages
Power BI reuses the same setting automatically — you aren't asked again
You must re-select the authentication method every single time
questions.explain: The authentication method is remembered for that address and reused for any page under it, so you're not prompted again on subsequent connections.
